description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per call — One $0.02 call returns the spreads, in percentage points, between two tenors (2s10s, 3m10y, 2s30s, 5s30s, 10s30s, 3m2y) for the requested date in the snapshot range 1990-01-02–2026-10-09; a spread is null when either tenor was not published that day. Data vintage: a fixed historical snapshot of the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates — business days 1990-01-02 through 2026-10-09, collected October 2026 from the official U.S. Department of the Treasury feed (fiscaldata.treasury.gov / home.treasury.gov), whose terms offer the data free, without restriction, for commercial redistribution. Dates after 2026-10-09 are not covered by this snapshot.

date.description: Business day YYYY-MM-DD within 1990-01-02..2026-10-09. Default: latest date in the snapshot (2026-10-09).
